svg.aria-label: iqforge - turn SDR captures into PyTorch datasets
svg.desc: A spectrogram of an SDR capture. On the left it is continuous; toward the right it separates into discrete dataset windows, the last of which are labelled bpsk and qpsk. A reference tone runs through the whole recording.
